title: Dead man switch set up in first call with Jeremy Corbell

tellings.quote: I told the very first conversation I had with Jeremy. I said, "Jeremy, I don't know you. You don't know me. I'm going to go become a congressional whistleblower.

plain: In his very first conversation with a man named Jeremy Corbell, Dylan Borland says he told him, "I don't know you. You don't know me. I'm going to go become a congressional whistleblower," meaning someone who reports hidden wrongdoing to Congress, and they set up a dead man switch, an arrangement to release information if something happened to him. Borland tells this about himself, as a sign of how much danger he felt he was in.
